title: Personalized Recommendation Pipeline
description: Builds a listener preference profile and seed-track feature analysis in parallel, generates and curates candidate recommendations, loops regeneration until a relevance/diversity bar is met, and gates editorial-playlist placement behind a human curator's approval.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: personalized-recommendation-pipeline
  title: Personalized Recommendation Pipeline
  description: Builds a listener preference profile and seed-track feature analysis in parallel,
    generates and curates candidate recommendations, loops regeneration until a relevance/diversity
    bar is met, and gates editorial-playlist placement behind a human curator's approval.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: "Builds a listener preference profile and seed-track feature analysis in parallel,
    generates and curates candidate recommendations, loops regeneration until a relevance/diversity
    bar is met, and gates editorial-playlist placement behind a human curator's approval. Trigger:
    user or upstream system supplies listening history and/or seed tracks"
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 4
    onFailure: stop
    requireApprovalFor:
      - n10
  nodes:
    - id: n1
      kind: input
      name: Listening History / Seed Tracks Intake
      summary: Listening History / Seed Tracks Intake
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - text
        properties:
          text:
            type: string
            description: The user's objective, source text, or instructions.
          workflowFields:
            type: object
            required:
              - user_id
              - listening_history
              - seed_tracks_optional
              - request_context
            properties:
              user_id: {}
              listening_history: {}
              seed_tracks_optional: {}
              request_context: {}
        x-ladder-input-mode: text
    - id: n2
      kind: agent
      templateRef: music-rec-01
      name: Build Preference Profile
      summary: Build Preference Profile
      role: Recommender-systems specialist building interpretable user taste profiles.
      prompt: You are a Listener Preference Profiler agent. You build a structured preference profile from
        listening history and/or explicit seed tracks, capturing genre, tempo, harmonic complexity,
        era, and artist affinities as distinct, inspectable dimensions rather than a single opaque
        embedding the user can't reason about. You distinguish stable long-term taste from recent or
        contextual listening (a workout playlist shouldn't overwrite everyday preference signal),
        and you flag when the available history is too thin or too narrow (e.g., only one genre) to
        produce a confident profile.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - domain-analysis
          - audio-processing
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
          - audio
        connectors:
          - api:music-catalog
          - mcp:daw
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n3
      kind: agent
      templateRef: music-an-02
      name: Extract Harmonic/Style Features of Seed Tracks
      summary: Extract Harmonic/Style Features of Seed Tracks
      role: Music theorist specializing in harmonic analysis — functional harmony, jazz chord-scale
        theory, and roman numeral analysis.
      prompt: You are a Chord & Harmony Analyzer agent. You identify chords and chord progressions from
        audio or symbolic input, label harmonic function using roman numeral analysis relative to
        the detected key (tonic, subdominant, dominant function), and detect the key itself along
        with any modulations. You distinguish genuinely ambiguous harmonic moments — a chord that
        could reasonably be analyzed two different ways depending on context — from cases with a
        single clear answer, and you present the ambiguity explicitly rather than forcing a single
        label where music theorists would actually disagree.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - domain-analysis
          - decision-analysis
          - audio-processing
        tools:
          - read
          - audio
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n4
      kind: join
      name: Merge Profile + Seed Features
      summary: Merge Profile + Seed Features
      config:
        join: all
    - id: n5
      kind: agent
      templateRef: music-rec-02
      name: Generate Candidate Recommendations
      summary: Generate Candidate Recommendations
      role: Recommender-systems engineer generating candidate track/playlist recommendations from a
        preference profile.
      prompt: You are a Music Recommendation Engine agent. You generate candidate recommendations by
        combining content-based similarity (audio and harmonic features) with collaborative signals
        (what listeners with similar profiles enjoyed), and you explain why each recommendation was
        surfaced in terms a listener would actually recognize ("similar tempo and harmonic
        complexity to X, popular among listeners of Y") rather than an unexplained black-box score.
        You avoid over-indexing on the single most recent listen at the expense of the broader
        profile, and you flag when the candidate pool for a request is thin (a very niche seed
        genre) rather than padding it with weak matches presented as strong ones.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - writing-editing
          - domain-analysis
          - operations-planning
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
          - audio
        connectors:
          - api:music-catalog
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n6
      kind: agent
      templateRef: music-rec-03
      name: Apply Discovery/Diversity Curation
      summary: Apply Discovery/Diversity Curation
      role: Recommender-systems specialist focused on catalog diversity and filter-bubble mitigation.
      prompt: You are a Discovery & Diversity Curator agent. Given a candidate recommendation list, you
        re-balance it for discovery by injecting a deliberate, bounded share of novel artists or
        genres adjacent to — but not identical to — the listener's established taste, while
        protecting against recommending material so far outside the profile that it reads as
        irrelevant noise. You track a diversity metric explicitly (genre spread, artist repetition,
        novelty ratio) rather than leaving "variety" as a vague, unmeasured adjustment, and you
        report the tradeoff you made between pure relevance and discovery so it's an inspectable
        choice, not a hidden one.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evaluation
          - domain-analysis
          - data-engineering
        tools:
          - read
          - audio
        connectors:
          - api:musicbrainz
          - mcp:daw
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n7
      kind: evaluate
      inlineRole: true
      name: Score Relevance & Diversity
      summary: Evaluate relevance and diversity index.
      role: Deterministic metric evaluator
      prompt: Evaluate the upstream result using relevance and diversity index. Return a score, pass/fail
        verdict, evidence, uncertainty, and the smallest corrective action. Do not claim
        programmatic measurement unless the host supplies the required tool.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - score
          - passed
          - reasons
        properties:
          score:
            type: number
          passed:
            type: boolean
          reasons:
            type: array
            items:
              type: string
      config:
        threshold: 0.8
    - id: n8
      kind: condition
      name: Meets Quality Bar
      summary: Meets Quality Bar
      config:
        expression: rec_score.relevance >= 0.7 AND rec_score.diversity >= 0.3
        branches:
          - label: "True"
            when: "true"
          - label: "False"
            when: "false"
    - id: n_loop4
      kind: loop
      name: Regenerate Until Quality Bar Met
      summary: Repeat a bounded revision sequence until rec_score meets quality bar.
      config:
        body:
          - n5
          - n6
          - n7
          - n8
        exitCondition: rec_score meets quality bar
        maxIterations: 3
        onExhausted: stop
    - id: n9
      kind: condition
      name: Editorial Placement Required
      summary: Editorial Placement Required
      config:
        expression: request_context == 'editorial_playlist'
        branches:
          - label: "True"
            when: "true"
          - label: "False"
            when: "false"
    - id: n10
      kind: approval
      name: Human Curator Approval for Editorial Playlist
      summary: Pause for music editorial curator; on timeout, escalate.
    - id: n11
      kind: agent
      templateRef: music-rec-02
      name: Deliver Final Playlist
      summary: Deliver Final Playlist
      role: Recommender-systems engineer generating candidate track/playlist recommendations from a
        preference profile.
      prompt: You are a Music Recommendation Engine agent. You generate candidate recommendations by
        combining content-based similarity (audio and harmonic features) with collaborative signals
        (what listeners with similar profiles enjoyed), and you explain why each recommendation was
        surfaced in terms a listener would actually recognize ("similar tempo and harmonic
        complexity to X, popular among listeners of Y") rather than an unexplained black-box score.
        You avoid over-indexing on the single most recent listen at the expense of the broader
        profile, and you flag when the candidate pool for a request is thin (a very niche seed
        genre) rather than padding it with weak matches presented as strong ones.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - writing-editing
          - domain-analysis
          - operations-planning
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
          - audio
        connectors:
          - api:music-catalog
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: workflow-output
      kind: output
      name: Validated result
      summary: Return the completed personalized recommendation pipeline deliverable, validation evidence,
        and unresolved uncertainty.
  edges:
    - id: wf-music-02-edge-1
      from: n1
      to: n2
      kind: data
    - id: wf-music-02-edge-2
      from: n1
      to: n3
      kind: data
    - id: wf-music-02-edge-3
      from: n2
      to: n4
      kind: data
    - id: wf-music-02-edge-4
      from: n3
      to: n4
      kind: data
    - id: wf-music-02-edge-5
      from: n4
      to: n5
      kind: data
    - id: wf-music-02-edge-6
      from: n5
      to: n6
      kind: data
    - id: wf-music-02-edge-7
      from: n6
      to: n7
      kind: data
    - id: wf-music-02-edge-8
      from: n7
      to: n8
      kind: data
    - id: wf-music-02-edge-9
      from: n8
      to: n9
      kind: control
      condition: "true"
    - id: wf-music-02-edge-10
      from: n8
      to: n_loop4
      kind: control
      condition: "false"
    - id: wf-music-02-edge-11
      from: n_loop4
      to: n9
      kind: control
      condition: loop_exit
    - id: wf-music-02-edge-12
      from: n9
      to: n10
      kind: control
      condition: "true"
    - id: wf-music-02-edge-13
      from: n9
      to: n11
      kind: control
      condition: "false"
    - id: wf-music-02-edge-14
      from: n10
      to: n11
      kind: control
      condition: approved
    - id: wf-music-02-output-1
      from: n11
      to: workflow-output
      kind: dependency
